translation: Calls on unlicensed servers are only available in DMs.
description: Ephemeral bot message shown to an end user who tries to start a call in a group or channel on an unlicensed server (fallback for older clients that can't show the error natively).

translation: We highly recommend [deploying the RTCD service](https://mattermost.com/pl/calls-deployment-the-rtcd-service) to offload calls processing to a separate instance in order to maintain the performance, scalability, and reliability of your main Mattermost server.
description: Recommendation paragraph appended after the intro in a warning DM the Calls bot sends to system admins on Enterprise-licensed servers when concurrent call sessions are high; contains a markdown link that must be preserved.

translation: Your installation is experiencing heavy usage from Mattermost Calls that can negatively impact system performance and responsiveness.
description: Opening paragraph of a warning DM the Calls bot sends to system admins when the number of concurrent call sessions is high; an edition-specific recommendation paragraph is appended after it, and the whole message is prefixed with a warning emoji.

translation: We highly recommend upgrading to [Enterprise](https://mattermost.com/pricing/) and [deploying the RTCD service](https://mattermost.com/pl/calls-deployment-the-rtcd-service) to offload calls processing to a separate instance in order to maintain the performance, scalability, and reliability of your main Mattermost server.
description: Recommendation paragraph appended after the intro in the admin warning DM about high concurrent call sessions, shown on Professional-licensed or unlicensed Enterprise-ready servers; contains two markdown links that must be preserved.

translation: We highly recommend switching to [Mattermost Enterprise Edition](https://mattermost.com/pl/install-enterprise-install-upgrade) and [deploying the RTCD service](https://mattermost.com/pl/calls-deployment-the-rtcd-service) to offload calls processing to a separate instance in order to maintain the performance, scalability, and reliability of your main Mattermost server.
description: Recommendation paragraph appended after the intro in the admin warning DM about high concurrent call sessions, shown on Team Edition servers; contains two markdown links that must be preserved.
Text the call post in the channel is updated to when the call finishes; also used as the title of the post's message attachment.

translation: Here's the call recording. Transcription is processing and will be posted when ready.
description: Message of a bot post in the call thread that attaches the finished call recording, used when transcriptions are enabled; the phrase 'of <call title> at <time> UTC' may be appended to it when the call has a title.
Message of a bot post in the call thread that attaches the finished call recording file; the phrase 'of <call title> at <time> UTC' may be appended to it when the call has a title.
Message of a bot post in the call thread that attaches the call transcription file; the phrase 'of <call title> at <time> UTC' may be appended to it when the call has a title.
Text of the post created in the channel when someone starts a call; {{.Username}} is the Mattermost username of the person who started it; also used as the post's attachment title.

Text of the post created in the channel when someone starts a call, used instead of the username variant when the server is configured to show full names; {{.FirstName}} and {{.LastName}} are the starter's first and last name; also used as the post's attachment title.

translation: You've been invited to a call
description: Body of the mobile push notification sent to DM/group members when a call starts and notification contents are restricted, so no sender name is included.

translation: {{.SenderName}} is inviting you to a call
description: Body of the mobile push notification sent to DM/group members when a call starts and full notification contents are allowed; {{.SenderName}} is the display name of the person who started the call.
Error message returned to system admins when saving the Calls plugin configuration in the System Console fails validation.
